proposals.before: While the court was at Fengxiang, Chengye repeatedly urged sending troops from Jin and Jiang to pin down Li Maozhen's Qi forces from the flank.
proposals.after: While the court was at Fengxiang, Chengye repeatedly urged sending troops from Jin and Jiang to pin down the Qi forces from the flank.
proposals.reason: Chinese has only 岐人 (the Qi people/forces); the idiomatic English invents the personal name Li Maozhen.

proposals.before: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Hanqiong was dispatched to campaign against Conghou and was also made acting administrator of the Tianxiong military governorship.)〉
proposals.after: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Hanqiong was dispatched to summon Conghou and was also made acting administrator of the Tianxiong military governorship.)〉
proposals.reason: In context 征從厚 means summon (徵) Conghou, matching the prior sentence about recalling Emperor Min; 'campaign against' reverses the sense.

proposals.before: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Hanqiong was dispatched to campaign against Conghou and was also made acting administrator of the Tianxiong military governorship.)〉
proposals.after: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Hanqiong was dispatched to summon Conghou and was also made acting administrator of the Tianxiong military governorship.)〉
proposals.reason: Same 征/徵 summon sense as in the idiomatic line; 'campaign against' is a clear semantic error.

decisions.reason: Focus unit has only 岐人 for the Qi forces; 李茂貞 / Li Maozhen is not in the Chinese. Removing the invented personal name restores fidelity without other change.

The Tongjian note 遣漢瓊征從厚 parallels the prior sentence 召閔帝於鄴: 征 stands for 徵 'summon,' not a military campaign against Conghou. 'Campaign against' reverses the sense; 'summon' matches the context and the succession that follows.
The literal field has the same error on 征從厚; with s0133's 召閔帝於鄴 and Conghou's subsequent accession, 'summon' is the correct reading and 'campaign against' is not.
